name: pg-playground
_comment: What the local `pg` (playground) deployment SHOULD have. The profile discovers what it DOES have; this file decides whether a gap is a bug (required -> FAIL) or legitimately N/A (absent -> SKIP).
pg is FLAT for testing: the PGR businessService and all complaint types live at the ROOT `pg`. pg.citya/citest/cityb/cityc exist as tenant rows but carry no PGR config.

_rationale.workflow.pgr.actions.ESCALATE: Required: the shipped PgrWorkflowConfig wires ESCALATE, so #521 must actually run here rather than self-skip. Currently absent from the dump — a real gap.
_rationale.mdms.rejectionReasons: Deliberate red, same call as bomet. RAINMAKER-PGR.RejectionReasons is absent from full-dump.sql entirely (0 rows, no schema). Marking it absent would hide a real gap behind a green run.
_rationale.personas.gro-with-department: Required: an ASSIGN-capable employee is the difference between the suite running and hard-failing at profile-setup.
_rationale.personas.ward-scoped-csr: Absent: no ward-scoped CSR is seeded, so boundary-jurisdiction-496 self-skips rather than asserting against another deployment's wards.
_rationale.locales.multi: Absent: the dump seeds en_IN only.
_rationale.tenant.citySubTenant: Absent: pg is targeted flat — the pg.* city rows carry no PGR config.
